name: evidence-lane-plugin
description: Private /EV-first Evidence Lane workflow with Git and local-code intake, eighteen immutable sectors, PV Refresh/Fuse, prompt-indexed rollback, Google Drive OAuth dependency, and direct accepted-PV handoff.

interface.shortDescription: Run /EV, Refresh, Fuse, and reversible PV state travel.
interface.longDescription: Evidence Lane starts with /EV, accepts one explicit Git or local-code source, governs one project/agent/task across eighteen deterministic SQLite/MMD/DOT sectors, builds PV1 once, incrementally Refreshes later evidence, Fuses only exact APPROVE with direct handoff, and supports six-way HIL plus prompt-indexed pointer-only rollback.
defaultPrompt: Run /ev and resume my persistent Evidence Lane state.
Use /git or /local for one explicit source and branch.
Run PV Refresh, then stop at Fuse or the six-way HIL.
